subject.title: fix: use invariant PT-PT formatting and update OpenClaw LKG

question: Should the Companion deliberately select OpenClaw 2026.7.1 as its last-known-good default despite current-head proof that it fails all three supported setup E2E shards?
rationale: Repository policy and the LKG contract favor a runtime-proven default, while the related alignment issue favors tracking current stable; only maintainers can authorize accepting that known release regression.

options.title: Retain the proven LKG
options.body: Land the invariant-formatting fix separately and keep 2026.6.11 until a newer release passes the real setup paths.

options.title: Wait for the upstream repair
options.body: Keep this PR open and rerun all setup shards after OpenClaw 2026.7.1 or its successor fixes the startup-migration failure.

options.title: Accept the known regression
options.body: Merge 2026.7.1 only with an explicit decision to make the supported setup and recovery paths unavailable until the core fix ships.

recommendation.title: Retain the proven LKG
recommendation.body: Land the invariant-formatting fix separately and keep 2026.6.11 until a newer release passes the real setup paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available project-level routing candidate for deciding whether the Companion may ship a known-failing core default.
